entities.summary: Boris Pavlovich Grabovsky was a Soviet engineer of Ukrainian descent who invented a first fully electronic TV set that was demonstrated in 1928. In 1925, one of the pioneers of television Boris Rosing advised and helped him apply for a patent of a fully electronic TV set called Telefot. Boris is the son of the Ukrainian poet Pavlo Hrabovsky.
